headline: Cleanse. 2-3 drops. Spread in gentle circles.
footnote: AI illustrations of a routine, not results. Use sunscreen during the day. 3.9 out of 5 stars from 1,800 reviews on beminimalist.co, captured 2026-10-02
layout_description: Headline across the top; three equal portrait frames left to right (Step 1 · Cleanse & tone / Step 2 · 2-3 drops / Step 3 · Gentle circles), each with a dark label bar along its bottom edge, showing AI-generated illustrations of the same person doing each routine step (frames_prompt); AI-GENERATED — ILLUSTRATIVE mark top-right; small real pack shot bottom-right; routine-not-results note and rating in the footnote band; CTA "Shop now" bottom-left.
image_prompt: Empty background scene only: a pale warm-grey plaster wall above a narrow stone basin shelf, soft warm evening light from the upper left. Off-white, soft natural light, few props, clinical minimal style. Square 1080x1080. Keep the whole central band of the frame as an empty clear space, evenly lit and calm, reserved for three image panels and copy placed later, and keep the lower right corner empty for a pack photo. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
adaptation_notes: Angle: routine journey (timeline, three frames of the same person). Frame labels come straight from the page's usage facts: after cleansing & toning, 2-3 drops, spread with gentle circular motion (F19); sunscreen in the day (F19) sits in the footnote because the frames show the evening. Kept: headline that names the steps in order (Foxtale), 'Step N' labels beside a person (Dot & Key), numbered frames in a row with one action each (Pilgrim). Dropped: 'Glow' and 'Treat' step names ('Treat' reads as a treatment claim), concern-led headline, the happy-model result feel, swatches and the checklist. No before/after, no time-to-result labels, no visible skin change: the frames show a routine, not a result. The frames are AI-generated (High risk, labelled); real consented photos would lower the risk. Rating in the footnote.

frames_prompt: The same Indian woman in her mid 20s with light-brown skin, her evening routine at her home bathroom basin, in all three panels wearing the same plain cotton top with her hair tied back, framed the same way from the shoulders up beside the basin, with the same off-white tiled wall and the same soft warm light from the upper left. Panel 1: she rinses her face with both cupped hands over the basin, eyes closed, then pats it dry with a plain white towel. Panel 2: her fingertips are pressed lightly against her cheek, as if pressing in a few drops, her other hand resting on the basin edge. Panel 3: both palms move across her cheeks in slow, gentle circles, her expression calm. Actions only: her skin looks identical in all three panels, with natural texture and true-to-life light-brown colour, and the three panels read as one continuous routine. No product, bottle, dropper, tube, jar or packaging anywhere in frame; no text, no letters, no logos, no brand names.
